items.title: RELIANCE
items.quote: Save [me], Hashem for there is no longer any devout man. For truthful people have disappeared from among men.
items.text: People I rely on may disappoint me, no matter how upright they appear to be. Therefore I will place my total bitachon in You alone. My guiding principle is to please You and do what is right.

items.title: FALSEHOOD
items.quote: [May Hashem cut down] those who have said, ‘By means of our tongues we will prevail!’
items.text: Base your relationships on truth, not on falsehood and deception.

items.title: DELIVERANCE
items.quote: Hashem will say, ‘I will now rise up, I will grant a deliverance [to save each one from the resha’im] who set a trap for him.’
items.text: Turn to Hashem to save those who have been victimized by the reshai’im of the world.”

items.title: TRUTH
items.quote: For the words of Hashem are pure words, like refined silver.
items.text: The words of the Torah that Hashem has given to mankind are absolutely reliable because they come from the Source of truth. Their purity is made all the more evident in comparison with the falsehood and hypocrisy that characterizes men.

items.title: BASENESS
items.quote: When baseness is exalted among the sons of men.
items.text: Don’t succumb to prevailing practices of falsehood and hypocrisy in business and the professions. Just because others are doing it doesn’t make it right.
